summary: A Yes vote enacts a countywide 0.125% sales tax in Kern County to fund the maintenance, improvement, and operation of the California Living Museum (CALM).

tax.text: A Yes vote increases the local sales tax by one-eighth of a percent to fund CALM.
tax.quote: Just a little bit — one penny for every $8 we spend.

tax.text: A No vote keeps the local sales tax from increasing for this measure and does not provide its proposed funding for CALM.
